source: 2015/TSB Vol 15 No 11 - New Dual S Optimizer Tool.pdf
title: Optimizer Tool Dual "S" Foaming Intake Tool
lead: MOC has developed a new Foaming Intake tool to accommodate the use of Optimizer™. This tool was created to service vehicles with two (2) throttle bodies, allowing the user to clean both throttle bodies simultaneously.
body: The MOC Optimizer™ product (Part No. 16501) is sold separately.
